description: This file defines the Event class within the OpenCart system, responsible for managing event registration, triggering, unregistration, and clearing based on triggers. It allows other parts of the system to listen for and respond to specific events.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Handles registration, triggering, and management of system events in OpenCart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Event class with a Registry object.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event trigger with an associated action and priority.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers all actions associated with a specific event.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a specific event trigger associated with a route.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all actions associated with a specific trigger.
